require 'faye/websocket'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'bcrypt'

module FeatureFlags
  DEFINITIONS = {
    'beta_dashboard' => { rollout: 0.1, tier: 'free' },
    'advanced_analytics' => { rollout: 0.5, tier: 'pro' },
    'admin_panel' => { rollout: 1.0, tier: 'enterprise' },
    'bulk_export' => { rollout: 0.3, tier: 'pro' }
  }.freeze

  def self.enabled_for?(flag_name, user)
    defn = DEFINITIONS[flag_name]
    return false unless defn
    return false unless tier_rank(user[:tier]) >= tier_rank(defn[:tier])
    user_hash = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{user[:id]}:#{flag_name}")[0..7].to_i(16)
    user_hash.to_f / 0xFFFFFFFF <= defn[:rollout]
  end

  def self.tier_rank(tier)
    { 'free' => 0, 'pro' => 1, 'enterprise' => 2 }[tier.to_s] || 0
  end
end

class UserStore
  PROTECTED_ATTRIBUTES = %w[id password_hash created_at].freeze
  ASSIGNABLE_ATTRIBUTES = %w[name email avatar_url preferences].freeze

  def initialize
    @users = {}
  end

  def create(attrs)
    id = SecureRandom.uuid
    user = { id: id, tier: 'free', role: 'member', created_at: Time.now.iso8601 }
    user.merge!(symbolize(attrs, context: :create))
    user[:password_hash] = BCrypt::Password.create(attrs['password']) if attrs['password']
    @users[id] = user
    sanitize_output(user)
  end

  def update(id, attrs, context: :default)
    user = @users[id]
    return nil unless user
    filtered = symbolize(attrs, context: context)
    user.merge!(filtered)
    sanitize_output(user)
  end

  def find(id)
    user = @users[id]
    user ? sanitize_output(user) : nil
  end

  private

  def symbolize(attrs, context: :default)
    result = {}
    attrs.each do |key, value|
      str_key = key.to_s
      next if PROTECTED_ATTRIBUTES.include?(str_key)
      if ASSIGNABLE_ATTRIBUTES.include?(str_key)
        result[str_key.to_sym] = value
      end
    end
    result
  end

  def sanitize_output(user)
    user.reject { |k, _| k == :password_hash }
  end
end

class WebSocketApp
  def initialize
    @store = UserStore.new
    @connections = {}
  end

  def call(env)
    if Faye::WebSocket.websocket?(env)
      ws = Faye::WebSocket.new(env)
      ws.on :message do |event|
        handle_message(ws, event)
      end
      ws.on :close do |_|
        @connections.delete(ws.object_id)
      end
      ws.rack_response
    else
      [200, { 'Content-Type' => 'text/plain' }, ['WebSocket server']]
    end
  end

  private

  def handle_message(ws, event)
    msg = JSON.parse(event.data)
    case msg['action']
    when 'register'
      user = @store.create(msg['data'] || {})
      @connections[ws.object_id] = { ws: ws, user_id: user[:id] }
      send_response(ws, 'registered', user)
    when 'update_profile'
      conn = @connections[ws.object_id]
      return send_error(ws, 'not_authenticated') unless conn
      result = @store.update(conn[:user_id], msg['data'] || {})
      send_response(ws, 'profile_updated', result)
    when 'feature_update'
      conn = @connections[ws.object_id]
      return send_error(ws, 'not_authenticated') unless conn
      user = @store.find(conn[:user_id])
      if FeatureFlags.enabled_for?('advanced_analytics', user)
        result = @store.update(conn[:user_id], msg['data'] || {}, context: :feature_update)
        send_response(ws, 'feature_updated', result)
      else
        send_error(ws, 'feature_not_available')
      end
    when 'check_flags'
      conn = @connections[ws.object_id]
      return send_error(ws, 'not_authenticated') unless conn
      user = @store.find(conn[:user_id])
      flags = FeatureFlags::DEFINITIONS.keys.map do |flag|
        [flag, FeatureFlags.enabled_for?(flag, user)]
      end.to_h
      send_response(ws, 'flags', flags)
    end
  rescue JSON::ParserError
    send_error(ws, 'invalid_json')
  end

  def send_response(ws, type, data)
    ws.send(JSON.generate({ type: type, data: data }))
  end

  def send_error(ws, error)
    ws.send(JSON.generate({ type: 'error', error: error }))
  end
end

app = WebSocketApp.new
Rack::Handler::Thin.run app, Port: 9292
